findings.title: Exhausted federated recovery credentials are never removed
findings.body: `RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential` now returns federated credentials before local ones, but this path still removes the credential using `removeStoredCredentialById`, which only removes credentials from Keycloak's local storage. When the exhausted credential is in user storage, it remains there and continues to be reported as configured and exposed in credential listings until replacement succeeds. Remove it through the appropriate user-storage mechanism, or otherwise ensure the exhausted federated credential is actually cleared.
